# Data Dictionary — Supply Chain KPI Project

**All data in this project is SIMULATED.** It was generated by `generate_data.py`
(fixed seed 42) to stand in for procurement data from source systems such as
Coupa and Delphi. No real supplier, price, or inventory data is used.

Period: **2026-05-01 to 2026-10-31** (6 months) · 3 sites (PHX-01, PHX-02, TEM-01) ·
10 suppliers · 40 SKUs · 732 purchase-order lines · 720 inventory snapshots ·
84 price changes.

## Files

### `purchase_orders.csv` — one row per PO line

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `po_id` | Purchase-order line ID (PO-1000 …) |
| `order_date` | Date the PO was placed |
| `site` | Receiving site (PHX-01 / PHX-02 / TEM-01) |
| `supplier_code`, `supplier_name` | Supplier |
| `sku`, `description`, `category` | Item ordered |
| `quantity` | Units ordered |
| `unit_price_usd` | Price per unit at order time |
| `promised_eta` | Delivery date the supplier promised |
| `actual_delivery_date` | Date the goods actually arrived |
| `lead_time_days` | Actual lead time (order → delivery) |
| `promised_lead_time_days` | Promised lead time |
| `on_time` | TRUE if `actual_delivery_date <= promised_eta` |
| `defective_qty` | Units received defective |

### `inventory.csv` — monthly snapshots, one row per site × SKU × month

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `snapshot_date` | Last day of the month |
| `site`, `sku`, `description`, `category` | Location and item |
| `on_hand_qty` | Units on hand at snapshot |
| `safety_stock_qty` | Safety stock = avg daily usage × lead time |
| `reorder_point_qty` | Reorder point = safety stock + 3 days of usage |
| `unit_price_usd` | Current unit price |
| `avg_daily_usage` | Average units used per day |

### `price_changes.csv` — one row per supplier price change

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `change_id` | Price-change ID |
| `change_date` | Date the new price took effect |
| `supplier_code`, `supplier_name` | Supplier |
| `sku`, `description` | Item repriced |
| `old_unit_price_usd`, `new_unit_price_usd` | Before / after |
| `change_pct` | `(new − old) / old × 100` |
| `reason` | Stated reason (fuel surcharge, contract renegotiation, …) |

## KPI definitions

| Metric | Formula | Grain | Refresh cadence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **On-time delivery (OTD) rate** | `count(on_time = TRUE) / count(POs) × 100` | Supplier, site, month | Weekly (POs close daily) |
| **Lead-time variance** | `actual_delivery_date − promised_eta`, in days (mean per group; positive = late) | Supplier, site | Weekly |
| **Average lead time** | `mean(lead_time_days)` | Supplier | Weekly |
| **Defect rate** | `sum(defective_qty) / sum(quantity) × 100` | Supplier | Monthly |
| **Stockout-risk SKUs** | SKUs where `on_hand_qty < safety_stock_qty` at the latest snapshot | Site, SKU | Monthly (snapshot) |
| **Excess inventory exposure** | `sum(max(on_hand_qty − reorder_point_qty, 0) × unit_price_usd)` | Site, category | Monthly |
| **Forecast vs orders** | Forecasted demand (avg daily usage × days in month) vs actual ordered quantity, per SKU/month — see note below | SKU, month | Monthly |
| **Price variance** | `mean(change_pct)` and `max(change_pct)` per supplier; price-change impact = `change_pct × recent order value` | Supplier | On change |
| **Total spend** | `sum(quantity × unit_price_usd)` over PO lines | Supplier, site, month | Weekly |

**Forecast vs orders note:** this dataset has no separate forecast file — the
forecast is defined as `avg_daily_usage × days in the month` (the planning
assumption baked into safety stock and reorder points), and actuals are the
ordered quantities in `purchase_orders.csv`. A real deployment would replace
that assumption with the forecast feed from the planning system and measure
forecast accuracy (MAPE) against it.
